explanation_en: A skewer combined with a deflection. The source position is marked as needing refinement; the existing annotation describes the intended line.

intro.popup_en: 💡 Skewer: Find the skewer in this position!

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rxf8+弃车引象到f8，再Rd8+将军串击！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rxf8+ sacrifices the rook to draw the bishop to f8, then Rd8+ starts the skewer.

moves.popup: 弃车将军！引诱黑象来到f8，为后续串击创造条件。
moves.popup_en: White sacrifices the rook with check, luring the black bishop to f8 and setting up the skewer.
The bishop captures the rook on f8.
The queen captures on h6, winning material.

moves.popup: 黑象吃后，但白方随即发动串击。
moves.popup_en: The bishop captures the queen, but White now launches the skewer.
The rook checks from d8 and begins the skewer.
